{"ops": [{"insert": "他建了世界上最大的独立SaaS组合，年入1亿美元"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收购25+品牌，400人团队，专注200-500万美元ARR的公司", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tim Schumacher是干嘛的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他从青少年时期就开始创业，最早做了Sedo.com，一个域名市场平台，运转了10年。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "后来成为天使投资人，又创立了几家公司。然后他发现了几个问题——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有才华的创始人burned out，困在业务里，或者尽管产品很好却无法进一步scale", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收购经常出问题，因为acquirers不懂怎么运营产品", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他自己更擅长scale而不是从零build", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "于是saas.group诞生了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在Tim在build世界上最大的independent SaaS brands平台。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "25+品牌，约400人，遍布30个国家。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们通常收购ARR在200-500万美元之间的SaaS公司。几个公司贡献中高7位数的ARR。总共现在1亿美元ARR。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Portfolio包括："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "GitTower.com —— 图形化GIT客户端", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ScraperAPI.com —— dev-friendly网页数据/爬虫工具", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Ayrshare.com —— 开发者社交媒体连接工具", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Prerender.io —— 帮助大网站在搜索引擎和AI中获得可见性", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "对saas.group来说，"产品"本身就是收购和运营模式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从第一次收购DeployBot.com开始，他们refine了技术due diligence、文化alignment、创始人友好模式的processes。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "建了一个repeatable engine：小的高性能团队 + 共享的central services（营销、DevOps、财务）。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "把这个engine应用到所有收购中。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果重来，他会更早formalize这个收购playbook，因为repeatability和structure被证明是最大的优势。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和bootstrapper mindset的创始人合作是主要优势。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这让团队高效frugal，因为创始人对产品take deep ownership。和他们的运营理念perfectly align。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "小的高性能团队持续outperform大org，给这些团队autonomy同时提供central support是最大的成功因素之一。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈方面，由于是收购independent brands，portfolio用各种stacks。没有强制的单一stack，但团队尽量limit variations以便知识transfer。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术due diligence focus on代码质量、可维护性、债务，而不是特定技术。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "共同主题是developer-driven stack decisions，偏向simplicity和long-term maintainability。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "增长不仅来自传统用户获取，还来自作为SaaS业务最founder-friendly home的reputation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "通过transparent、honoring deals、让品牌保持independent来保持strong reputation。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "创始人、brokers、投资者的word of mouth带来了稳定的inbound对话和收购机会。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""传统"用户/客户获取方面，他们用正常的SaaS playbook："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Content marketing", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEO", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SEA", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Social", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Product-led growth", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没什么unusual的"hacks"。营销团队只是非常good和efficient in execution。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收入增长通过internationalization、better marketing、pricing improvements，以及简单地说——improving the product。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "六、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "收购后如何发展品牌？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "保持团队专注，在需要的地方用shared services提供leverage。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "确保继续发展所有品牌，根据各自需要：有些需要营销、sales、go-to-market策略如internationalization；有些需要彻底rethink产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "举个例子：AddSearch.com，给网站owner的搜索工具。Classic search变得less important，品牌需要reinvent自己。团队成功launch了"AI Answers"，AI-based answer engine，帮助恢复增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有Keyword.com。Classic SEO/keyword monitoring变得less interesting，ARR在decline直到几个月前团队launch了工具track brand visibility across所有主要AI search平台，包括ChatGPT、AI Mode、Perplexity、Gemini。这帮助恢复ARR增长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们还通过降低infrastructure成本和运营consistency来cut costs。Prerender.com加入后AWS成本降低80%，alone就增加了几十万美元bottom line。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "七、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "给创始人的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Prepare well，understand your numbers，early talk to real users。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "其他一切都会compound from that。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "如果考虑出售，像对待PMF一样对待它：have conversations，learn buyers care about什么，come prepared。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最重要的是：stay focused on building something people truly want，避免把自己的业务和扭曲期望的unicorn stories比较。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "saas.group的故事是一个关于scale和system的故事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是从零build，而是识别已经validated的产品，用成熟的运营模型让它们更好。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Tim的核心洞察——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Repeatability和structure是最大的优势。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有对founder-friendly的坚持。不是买公司来 dismantle，而是让它们继续independent成长。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这是双赢的模型。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: He built the worlds largest independent SaaS portfolio one hundred million annual income. Acquiring twenty five plus brands four hundred person team focusing on companies with two to five hundred thousand ARR. What does Tim Schumacher do. He started entrepreneurship from teenage years earliest made Sedo.com domain marketplace platform ran for ten years. Later became angel investor founded several companies. Then he discovered several problems. Talented founders burned out stuck in business or despite good product cannot further scale. Acquisitions often have problems because acquirers do not know how to operate product. He himself better at scaling than building from zero. So saas.group was born. One. Now Tim is building worlds largest independent SaaS brands platform. Twenty five plus brands around four hundred people across thirty countries. They typically acquire SaaS companies with ARR between two hundred to five hundred thousand dollars. Several companies contribute mid seven figure ARR. Total now one hundred million ARR. Portfolio includes GitTower.com graphical GIT client ScraperAPI.com dev friendly web data scraper tool Ayrshare.com open.
